snippet.title: Supreme Court Experience
snippet.description:
Step inside Canada’s highest court with Supreme Court Experience — an immersive project that opens the doors of Canadian justice like never before.

Born from the collaboration of researchers, legal experts, educators, and media creators, this groundbreaking educational project unfolds through two free, online experiences:

Echoes of the Court — An immersive video game that invites you to explore the spaces and stories that have shaped the Supreme Court of Canada.

Keys to the Court — An interactive Docu-Course combining documentary vignettes and interactive content to shed light on the Court’s role, its impact on our lives, and the voices of those who have lived it — judges, lawyers, and citizens. 

Play. Learn. Discover: https://supremecourtexperience.ca/
